proves.claim: Whoami with board.url set requests the seat's agent route and no GET .../state, and prints the seat's lane.

cli.io-remote-board.whoami-reads-the-sea.why: Without it, a regression where whoami reads the 10 MB board state again would pass unnoticed and time out on a slow board host.

proves.claim: Pullboard test in a URL-joined clone finds the seat's claimed item from its agent route and requests no GET .../state.

cli.io-remote-test-receipt.claim-from-se.why: Without it, a regression where pullboard test reads the whole board state to find its claim would pass unnoticed.
